storyBible.storyStyle: Immersive, high-stakes epic fantasy with vivid atmospheric worldbuilding, ancient cosmic magic, and deep lore.
storyBible.narratorStyle: Third-Person Limited, grounded, atmospheric, and sensory-heavy.
storyBible.writingRules: Show, don't tell. Focus on visceral sensory details—the chill of cosmic mana, heavy plate armor, ancient runes, and tense character dialogue. Avoid info-dumps.
storyBible.promptRules: Open with immediate action or a striking atmospheric detail. Use natural, grounded dialogue. End each chapter on high tension, a cosmic revelation, or a cliffhanger.
storyBible.forbiddenRules: No easy resolutions, no sudden generic positive outcomes, do not use overly purple prose, never summarize dramatic scenes that can be experienced through dialogue.
storyBible.customInstructions: Weave in subtle atmospheric details like the faint hum of celestial magic, ancient glowing runes, and shifts in atmospheric pressure during magic invocation.

worldLore.setting: The Realm of Aethelgard within the Grande Cosmic expanse, floating beneath the shattered Astral Citadel and guarded by celestial ley lines.
worldLore.faith: The Celestial Core worship—a radiant cosmic gem believed to be the heart of the universe, holding back the abyssal void.
worldLore.magicSystem: Celestial & Rune Magic—channeling ancient cosmic mana through runic-carved silver blades and celestial astrology.
worldLore.threats: Voidborn Entities—monstrous abyssal creatures creeping from the cosmic rift, repelled only by unstable Astral Core resonance.

characters.name: Sir Silas Vance
characters.personality: Cynical, meticulous, fiercely protective of the forgotten sectors, struggling with the corruption of a shattered astral core.
characters.relationships: Former sworn brother of Arch-Mage Thai (deceased); deeply distrusts the High Council executives of Aethelgard.
characters.biography: Dishonorably stripped of his knighthood after refusing orders to purge a starving district during the Mana Eclipse. Now operates as a rogue mercenary in the outer realms.
characters.notes: Wields a heavy, runic-carved silver broadsword. His left eye glows with a dangerous, unstable cosmic essence from an ancient ritual.

characters.name: Lyra Thorne
characters.personality: Pragmatic, sharp-tongued, fiercely independent, highly perceptive of magical flows.
characters.relationships: Reluctant ally to Sir Silas Vance; enemy of the High Council Inquisitors.
characters.biography: Born in the lower slums beneath the Astral Citadel. Possesses a rare natural ability to see cosmic ley lines and structural flaws in celestial magic.
characters.notes: Carries dual runic daggers; capable of reading ancient celestial runes instantly.

lastSummary: This is the very first episode. Introduce the world of Grande Cosmic, the icy chill of ancient celestial magic, and the tense initial confrontation between Sir Silas Vance and Lyra Thorne beneath the restricted sub-crypts of the Astral Citadel.
